subject: BENCHMITTENS
name: Mittens — fine drawing, pale gold, charcoal curls

styleSelection.reason: Light dry-base watercolor planes with selectively softened turns; thin sepia drawing carries eyes and directional whiskers. One middle layer and two connected shadow glazes retain white paper and avoid nested patchwork.

families.referenceCue: Two upward-looking pale olive eyes: narrow dark upper lids, elongated pupils, tiny white catchlights. Dry focal paint; fitted linework. Single middle wash; retain fitted target geometry and dry focal edges. Sub-four-cell strands use selected ink, not speckled paint.

Tall pointed ears and ginger forehead bars separated by white fur; pale warm base, dry shaped ochre and sienna planes. Single middle wash; retain fitted target geometry and dry focal edges. Sub-four-cell strands use selected ink, not speckled paint.

White muzzle, brown nose and mouth junction; slight warm-grey chin shade and long fine whiskers. Keep broad paper white. Single middle wash; retain fitted target geometry and dry focal edges. Sub-four-cell strands use selected ink, not speckled paint.

Connected warm ginger cheek planes with irregular white stripe gaps; dry shaped planes and a shared shadow glaze down the right neck. Single middle wash; retain fitted target geometry and dry focal edges. Sub-four-cell strands use selected ink, not speckled paint.

White bib and pale shoulder; lost paper edges, sparse ochre along left outer shoulder. Single middle wash; retain fitted target geometry and dry focal edges. Sub-four-cell strands use selected ink, not speckled paint.

Ginger right neck continues cheek, medium ochre and sienna with directional white gaps; deepest narrow contact shadow against the person. Single middle wash; retain fitted target geometry and dry focal edges. Sub-four-cell strands use selected ink, not speckled paint.

Charcoal curls, cool neutral rather than brown. Connected Payne's-grey value wash over dry paper, one middle wash and two dry shadow glazes, preserving target paper openings. Selected long contour curls only in ink.

Dark brows and fine upper lids above light eye sockets; keep eye whites lightly tinted and the fitted pupil glints. Single middle wash; retain fitted target geometry and dry focal edges. Sub-four-cell strands use selected ink, not speckled paint.

Very pale warm skin, nearly paper nose bridge and central cheek. Thin ochre/sienna wash, one restrained middle plane, shared temple-to-jaw shadow glaze. Soften only low-contrast turning boundaries with clean damp brush; dry nostrils and smile.
